<thought>Construct the retrosynthetic tree using the five specified templates in the required order.  
- Apply template 29646 to the target to introduce a silyl‑protected intermediate.  
- Apply template 1914389 to that intermediate, generating two precursors (one main fragment and a reagent).  
- Apply template 1914390 to the main fragment from the previous step.  
- Apply template 149040 to the resulting fragment.  
- Finally, apply template 1914391 to reach simple, commercially available building blocks.  

The JSON below follows the exact schema required, with each reaction node containing the appropriate template_id and its precursor molecules as child “mol” nodes.** 

```json
{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 29646,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914389,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914390,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)C1C)CO"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 149040,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C1C)CO"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O=C=O"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": 1914391,
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C)C1C)CO"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O=CC=O"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
